scenarios.intent: Encode a value fitting in one LEB128 byte (e.g. 42). Best-case encode throughput. Confirms zero heap allocation per call.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: Run with TrackingAllocator (track_allocations=true). Assert alloc_count==0 across all sampled iterations. Body uses only stack-allocated buf[10] for output.
scenarios.workload_description: Loop ops_per_iteration times calling writeVarInt(&buf, 42). buf is a [10]u8 on the stack. Pass returned byte count to std.mem.doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (utils.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Encode u64 MAX (10-byte LEB128). Exercises the full shift loop and confirms overflow is not triggered.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: Same as varint_encode_1byte. Stack buffer only.
scenarios.workload_description: Loop ops_per_iteration times calling writeVarInt(&buf, std.math.maxInt(u64)). Pass returned byte count to std.mem.doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (utils.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Decode a one-byte LEB128 value from a stack-allocated buffer. Zero heap. Establishes best-case decode ns/op.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: Input buffer is a const [1]u8 on the stack. readVarInt returns a struct on the stack. No heap path in the decode loop for valid inputs.
scenarios.workload_description: Pre-encode value 42 into a stack buffer before the timed loop. Loop ops_per_iteration times calling readVarInt(buf[0..]). Pass val and bytes_read to doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (utils.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Decode a 10-byte LEB128 value. Exercises the overflow guard at shift==63 (SEC-EXT-0210).
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: Same as varint_decode_1byte. Stack buffer only.
scenarios.workload_description: Pre-encode std.math.maxInt(u64) into a [10]u8 stack buffer before the timed loop. Loop calling readVarInt. Pass val and bytes_read to doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (utils.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Measure BM25 score arithmetic in isolation. tf=3, df=100, N=10000, dl=50, avg_dl=50. Confirms zero heap allocation per call.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: BM25 arithmetic uses only register-resident floats. No heap path. TrackingAllocator alloc_count must remain 0.
scenarios.workload_description: Inline the BM25 formula (idf * tf_norm) using fixed constants. Loop ops_per_iteration times. Pass f32 result to doNotOptimizeAway. Do not call into Engine or TermIterator; compute the formula directly to keep the scenario dependency-free.
preservation_impact: zig build test (search.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Measure O(segments) norm lookup cost for a 16-segment engine. Exposes the linear scan over segment norm maps.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: 16 norm maps are allocated once before the timed loop (in setup, not in the body). The timed body only calls get() on each. alloc_count across sampled iterations must be 0.
do_not_optimize_away_targets: dl_u32 (u32) looked up from norm table
scenarios.workload_description: Create an array of 16 AutoHashMapUnmanaged(u64, u32) pre-populated with 1000 doc_id->length entries each (seeded, deterministic). Timed body: for each iteration, scan all 16 maps looking for a fixed doc_id (present in the last map to exercise worst-case). Compute BM25 score with the found dl. Pass dl_u32 and score to doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (search.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Serialize one WalRecord into a reused ArrayListUnmanaged scratch buffer via serializeInto. Converges to zero allocs after first call as scratch buffer pre-grows.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: alloc_count is expected to be 0 across all SAMPLED iterations (warmup allows initial scratch growth). If alloc_count > 0 in sampled iterations, the scratch buffer is being reset incorrectly. Check that clearRetainingCapacity() is called, not deinit()+init().
scenarios.workload_description: Construct one WalRecord with record_type=.index_doc, txn_id=1, doc_id=42, payload=16-byte fixed slice. Allocate one ArrayListUnmanaged(u8) as scratch before the timed loop. Each iteration: clearRetainingCapacity(), call record.serializeInto(allocator, &scratch), pass scratch.items[0] to doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (wal.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Index 100,000 documents each with 8 random terms from a 50,000-word vocabulary. Measures full engine throughput including WAL append+fsync, Memtable.addPosting, and auto-flush. Named scenario from PERF_GAP_ANALYSIS roadmap.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: alloc_count per iteration is expected to be high (addPosting allocates per new term key). Record the baseline alloc_count as the tracking metric for the future SoA refactor (PERF-0016). No assertion; value is informational.
scenarios.workload_description: Before timed body: init DefaultPrng with seed 0xdeadbeef_cafef00d. Build a vocabulary of 50,000 terms as fixed strings (word_00000..word_49999). Each iteration: create fresh Engine in isolated tmpdir, index ops_per_iteration documents each with 8 randomly-selected terms (1 position per term: [doc_id % 100]). Engine.deinit at end of iteration. The workload generator (vocabulary + prng) is set up in user_data before the scenario runs so the timed body only calls indexDocument.
preservation_impact: zig build test
zig build test-integration
benchmark-regression CI job (existing scenarios must not regress)

scenarios.intent: Build a Memtable with 100,000 distinct terms (1 posting each, 1 position) then flush. Isolates writeDictionaryAndPostings + writeNorms. Named scenario from PERF_GAP_ANALYSIS roadmap.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: alloc_count captures all allocations during the flush (dict_buf, post_buf, norms_buf growths). Record as baseline for PERF-0004 improvements. No assertion; value is informational.
scenarios.workload_description: Before timed body (in warmup): build Engine, insert 100,000 documents each with a unique term (term_00000..term_99999), 1 position per term, but do NOT trigger auto-flush (keep docs below DEFAULT_MEMTABLE_FLUSH_THRESHOLD_DOCS by using a single doc per term with doc_id = term_index). Timed body: call engine.flush(). Create a new Engine with fresh tmpdir per sample iteration so each flush measures a cold segment write. The 100k-term memtable construction must happen outside the timed region — place it in a setup step driven by iteration_index==0 detection or via user_data holding a pre-built Engine reference.
preservation_impact: zig build test
zig build test-integration
benchmark-regression CI job (existing scenarios must not regress)

scenarios.intent: Replay a pre-generated WAL with 1,000,000 index_doc records (bracketed begin/commit, 16-byte payload each). Measures three-pass replay cost. Named scenario from PERF_GAP_ANALYSIS roadmap.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: alloc_count expected ~3M (one dupe per record payload plus hash map entries). Record as baseline for future streaming two-pass replay optimization (WRK-025 follow-up). No assertion.
scenarios.workload_description: Before timed body (once, in warmup iteration): write a WAL file with 1,000,000 records. Each record: record_type=index_doc, txn_id=i, doc_id=i, payload=16 deterministic bytes (e.g. little-endian i repeated). Bracket each with begin (txn_id=i) and commit (txn_id=i) records so the three-pass replayer applies all records. Use WalWriter.append (not appendAndSync) for speed during WAL construction. Sync once at the end. Store the pre-built directory path in user_data. Timed body: call Engine.init on that directory (which triggers replayWal), then engine.deinit(). Copy the pre-built directory to a fresh tmpdir per sample so each replay starts from the same WAL bytes.
preservation_impact: zig build test
zig build test-integration
benchmark-regression CI job (existing scenarios must not regress)

scenarios.intent: Query a term across 16 flushed segments. Advance TermIterator to exhaustion with positions. Measures end-to-end query path including BM25 scoring and norm lookup. Named scenario from PERF_GAP_ANALYSIS roadmap.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: alloc_count expected to be non-zero (SegmentReader.search allocates the postings data buffer per segment per call). Record as baseline. No assertion.
do_not_optimize_away_targets: match.doc_id (u64) on each iteration of TermIterator.next
scenarios.workload_description: Before timed body (once, in warmup): init Engine, index 160,000 documents across 16 explicit flush boundaries (10,000 docs per flush, each doc has term 'bench_query' plus 7 random terms from a 1000-word vocab). Store engine reference in user_data. Timed body: call engine.search('bench_query'), advance iterator until null, counting matches. Pass last match doc_id to doNotOptimizeAway. Assert match count equals 160,000.
preservation_impact: zig build test
zig build test-integration
benchmark-regression CI job (existing scenarios must not regress)

scenarios.intent: Decode one posting including positions from a pre-loaded 10,000-entry posting buffer. Paired with posting_iter_next_doc_only to isolate the position decode cost.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: pos_buf growth may occur on first call. After warmup, pos_buf is pre-sized and subsequent calls reuse capacity. alloc_count in sampled iterations should be 0 if tf is constant across all postings. Assert alloc_count==0 after warmup.
scenarios.workload_description: Before timed body: construct a postings.bin-format byte buffer with 10,000 postings, each with tf=4, positions=[0,1,2,3] delta-encoded. Use a seeded PRNG for doc_id deltas (all delta=1 for simplicity). Construct a PostingIterator pointing at this buffer with df=10,000. Timed body: reset iterator to start, loop ops_per_iteration times calling next(), pass doc_id and positions.len to doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (segment.zig unit tests must pass)

scenarios.intent: Same buffer as posting_iter_next_with_positions but calls nextDocOnly, skipping position decode. The throughput delta vs the paired scenario isolates per-position varint decode cost.
scenarios.alloc_probe_plan: nextDocOnly does not grow pos_buf. alloc_count must be 0 across all sampled iterations (including first sampled iteration, unlike next()). Assert strictly.
scenarios.workload_description: Identical buffer and iterator setup as posting_iter_next_with_positions. Timed body calls nextDocOnly() instead of next(). Pass doc_id to doNotOptimizeAway.
preservation_impact: zig build test (segment.zig unit tests must pass)

new_files.description: Micro-benchmark suite for readVarInt and writeVarInt. Four scenarios: encode 1-byte, encode 10-byte, decode 1-byte, decode 10-byte.
Micro-benchmark suite for BM25 scoring arithmetic. Two scenarios: single-call score computation, 16-segment norm scan.
Micro-benchmark for WalRecord.serializeInto with scratch buffer reuse.

Add bench-micro-varint, bench-micro-bm25, bench-micro-wal-record exe blocks modeled on micro_example_exe. Wire each into micro_all_step.dependOn(...).
